abstention_prompts.unsupported_foliage: Insufficient tomato foliage detected (< 15%). Point camera directly at a tomato leaf.
abstention_prompts.unsupported_blur: Camera motion blur detected. Hold the device steady and focus on foliar lesions.
abstention_prompts.uncertain_margin: Foliar pattern ambiguous between Early and Late Blight. Inspect under natural diffuse light or consult a plant pathologist.
abstention_prompts.field_illumination: Excessive glare or severe shadow detected. Shield leaf from direct harsh sunlight.
